attr.title: Alex the Allegator 4
attr.desc: A GameBoy-style Allegro platform game. Guide Alex the Allegator through 10 levels to rescue his family, with 23 bundled fan-made bonus level packs to pick from at startup.
attr.desc_md: A GameBoy-style platform game by [Johan Peitz](http://allegator.sourceforge.net/) / Free Lunch Design. Guide Alex the Allegator through 10 levels, spitting cherries and jumping on enemies to rescue his captured family. This port also bundles 23 fan-made custom level packs sourced from the game's own community map page, selectable from a startup menu alongside the original campaign.
attr.inst: Ready to run. On startup, pick the main campaign or browse a curated set of bonus community level packs.
